technique_name: Write a story about a traveling salesman who visits a small town.
description: John was a traveling salesman who had been on the road for weeks. One night, he stopped in a small town to rest for the night. After having dinner at the local diner, he decided to take a walk around town. Everywhere he looked, he was met with friendly smiles. He soon found himself in the town square where a local band was playing. The music and atmosphere put a smile on John's face.
